_noteEBackstab: E MAXIMUM DAMAGE, CORRECTED (loop 486, user: the maximum is (E damage x1.5 vs a low target) PLUS (backstab dagger x1.5 vs a low target)). Loop 485 got this half right and half wrong, and the half it got wrong was an omission I never even saw. TWO amplifications exist, not one, and they share the same gate. (1) TwoShivPoison carries TotalExecuteDamage = TotalDamage x ExecuteDamagePercent 1.5, gated by its own ExecuteHealthThreshold 0.3 - the DAGGER ITSELF hits 50% harder against a target below 30% maximum health, and that was never curated at all; E was a flat TotalDamage. (2) ShacoPassives ShivDamageExecute = ShivDamage x ShivExecuteDamagePercent 1.5 is the backstab payload at the same threshold. So the ceiling is TotalExecuteDamage + ShivDamageExecute, which is exactly what the user stated. WHAT LOOP 485 GOT WRONG: it argued the two tiers could not be layered because a node carries one condition flag and two conditional hits would both fire off one checkbox. Both halves of that are true and the conclusion did not follow - firing together is CORRECT here, because both amplifications are the same 30% threshold. One click, both tiers, and the number that comes out is the real maximum. Each hit still DECLARES its own primary gate (HpBelow 0.3 on the dagger, FromBehind on the payload) so the file says what each one actually needs; they resolve off the one node flag, so ticking it asserts the whole best case - behind the target and below the threshold - which is what a maximum-damage checkbox means. Unticked is the plain dagger from the front, byte-identical to the curation before loop 485. Wiki cross-check (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shaco, 2026-08-21): the backstab payload reads 15-54.12 (+10% AP) rising to 22.5-81.18 (+15% AP) below 30% health, and 22.5/15 = 1.5 confirms the multiplier from the other direction.
